name: Iset
passives: Solar Edict: Iset gains Solar Charge when sustain play banks survival value through terrain mastery and converts it into recovery on Aten-lit judgment ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a Ma’at balance rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Solar Dominion of Khepra.
lore: Iset, Throne-Magic Mother, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Aten Ra. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: restoration goddess, throne magic, river afterlife passage, sacred motherhood and sovereign healing. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses restoration goddess, throne magic, river afterlife passage, sacred motherhood and sovereign healing; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Aten Ra canon.
visualDescription: Iset manifests as restoration goddess, throne magic, river afterlife passage, sacred motherhood and sovereign healing from Aten Ra: beautiful feminine Egyptian queen face, almond eyes, soft full mouth, compassionate but commanding gaze; graceful feminine hourglass frame, elegant waist-to-hip line, poised healer posture; signature silhouette: throne crown, flowing linen wings, curved scepter, protective mother-queen outline. Weapon: throne scepter and river-linen restoration fan. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Iset — Ma’at-Weighted Strike Restore
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Aten Ra source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Solar Charge gain when used from Aten-lit judgment ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Pylon Edict Technique — Covenant
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to restores through faction ritual, cleanses pressure, and rewards holding sacred ground without becoming a passive healer. Builds Solar Charge only when the Avatar uses Aten-lit judgment ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Iset: Sun-Scale Decree Renewal Rite
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Solar Charge to impose a two-round rule from Solar Dominion of Khepra: restores through faction ritual, cleanses pressure, and rewards holding sacred ground without becoming a passive healer. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Aten-Ra Source Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Solar Charge, transform nearby terrain into Aten-lit judgment ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Iset Restorer Ma’at Was-Sceptre Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through Aten-lit judgment ground. Visual: Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Iset Electrum Wesekh Source-Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Solar Dominion of Khepra source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Iset Khepri Solar Scarab Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Solar Charge and unlocks a mastery branch for Aten Hand-Ray Gate Step, Uraeus Counter-Edict, and Weigh the Name. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: win attrition and cleanse hazard pressure
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Iset's Solar Edict: a solo mechanic where Solar Charge grows through Aten-lit judgment ground, reaction-window mastery, and sustain decisions that bank survival value through terrain mastery and convert it into recovery. Payoff: survive long missions without ally healing or generic lifesteal. Counterplay: anti-heal pressure and hazard denial starve recovery; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: anti-heal pressure and hazard denial starve recovery
